methodology.coldDefinition: A fresh clone of a sealed current-schema fixture is opened by a new packaged release process.
methodology.warmDefinition: The same isolated fixture is reopened after the paired cold process exits cleanly.
methodology.observationWindow: Renderer module load through first shell commit plus 1500 ms of visible post-paint recovery.
methodology.rss: Maximum resident bytes sampled from the application process and its descendant process tree. Platform WebView helpers outside that tree are not claimed.
methodology.privacy: Only closed stage names, numeric timings/counts, app/OS/WebView versions, and aggregate RSS are retained. IPC arguments/responses, SQL, rows, prompts, paths, credentials, and raw logs are never written to the artifact.
